## Wave 3 Summary

This wave supplies spectral-geometer's heat-kernel adjudication of the two joints where all three investigation-1 surveys independently converge. It translates three seed findings into three type-distinct gates: (1) a **compute** that scans the un-protected a₄ Seeley-DeWitt coefficient on the **L_max axis** at τ_fold and asks whether the m_H +5.36% residual is a resolvable truncation tail (a₄ tail monotone-decreasing toward the continuum Gilkey value) or a physical floor; (2) a **workshop** — the one genuine Q1a adjudication of inv-5 — between connes-ncg-theorist and landau-condensed-matter-theorist on whether the spectral action `Tr f(D²)` is the substrate's effective action / free energy, the two advocates co-citing the SAME S37 93×-BCS-wrong-sign result from opposite domains; (3) a **review** that synthesizes the THREE independent readings of the +5.36% Higgs residual (connes' Pati-Salam quartic INV5-W1-1, landau's Pekker-Varma self-energy INV5-W2-3, spectral-geometer's a₄ L_max-tail INV5-W3-1) into one picture. The gate-type mix is compute × 1 + workshop × 1 + review × 1; only the compute gate emits a verdict line, the workshop and review close by artifact-existence-with-content per `gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path"`.

## Wave 3 Decision Point Prerequisites

- **INV5-W3-1 (compute)**: no upstream-gate prereq. Reads the on-disk D_K irrep-construction machinery (`computations/_shared/dirac_spectrum.py`, `computations/_shared/spectral_action.py`) + `canonical_constants.py`. May run in parallel with W1/W2 (independent of their verdicts; `investigation-5-partition.md §"Wave-order dependency"`).
- **INV5-W3-2 (workshop)**: no upstream-gate prereq. Reads the three cited survey sections + spectral-geometer's G4 split values as cited evidence. Independent of W1/W2 verdicts; may run in parallel with them. It is an exploratory adjudication (domain advocates argue their case), NOT a Stage-2 joint-theorem cross-check, so the `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"` no-prior-workshop-context rule does NOT apply — the two advocates are SUPPOSED to bring their domain reading.
- **INV5-W3-3 (review)**: PREREQ = the deliverables/verdicts of **INV5-W1-1** (connes Pati-Salam quartic), **INV5-W2-3** (landau Pekker-Varma self-energy), **INV5-W3-1** (this wave's a₄ L_max-tail compute). If any prereq is unmet at dispatch, the review closes per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md §"When mechanical closure IS acceptable"` (PRE-REG-INC, blocked-by-`<prereq>`, deferred to inv-5 close) — it does NOT block, and it does NOT emit a verdict line (review gates never do). The review synthesizes whatever subset of the three has landed and explicitly flags the missing legs.

## §W3-1. INV5-W3-1

```yaml
# ---- Identity (7 fields) ----
gate_id: "INV5-W3-1"
schema_version: "R3"
gate_type: "compute"
trigger: "[SIGN]"                          # directional prediction: a₄ truncation tail DECREASES with L_max
classification: "GEOMETRIC"                # a Seeley-DeWitt coefficient of D_K — the fabric's spectral content, not its excitations
agent_type: "spectral-geometer"
hypothesis: >
  The un-protected (extensive) fourth Seeley-DeWitt coefficient a₄ of D_K² at τ_fold, evaluated on the
  finite Peter-Weyl truncation at max_pq_sum (=L_max) ∈ {3,4,5,(6)}, has a truncation tail that is
  monotone-DECREASING toward a continuum limit, with the magnitude of the residual tail at L_max=3→6
  matching the +5.36% m_H residual — i.e. the m_H +5.36% / 38.5σ miss is the a₄ extensive truncation
  tail at L_sat=6 (RESOLVABLE), NOT a physical floor.

# ---- gate_type dispatch + closure ----
# compute — one subagent (spectral-geometer) runs the producing script; closes on a VERDICT LINE
# (emit_verdict, track="investigation") + WP section. review:/workshop: blocks OMITTED (not this type).

method:
  description: >
    Scan the heat-kernel Seeley-DeWitt extraction over the Peter-Weyl truncation parameter max_pq_sum
    (= L_max) at fixed τ = τ_fold = 0.190. For each max_pq_sum ∈ {3,4,5,(6)}: collect the D_K spectrum
    via the recursive-Casimir-projection irrep builder (collect_spectrum / get_irrep), form the heat trace
    t⁴·K(t) = a_0 + a_2 t + a_4 t² + a_6 t³ + a_8 t⁴ + O(t⁵), and read off a_4 via the robust polynomial
    fit (extract_seeley_dewitt_robust). Record a_4(max_pq_sum) as the EXTENSIVE coefficient (no a_0/a_2
    ratio normalization — the un-protected magnitude is the object under test, per spectral-geometer LB1).
    Compute the per-step convergence slope Δa_4(L) = a_4(L) − a_4(L−1) and the total-tail fraction
    |a_4(L_max) − a_4(3)| / a_4(L_max). Compare the total-tail fraction to the +5.36% m_H residual.
    DISTINCTION (state in WP): this is the L_max-AXIS convergence of the EXTENSIVE coefficient's MAGNITUDE,
    structurally DISTINCT from inv-3 INV3-W2-2, which scans the τ-AXIS for bit-identical {a_0,a_2,a_4}
    MULTISETS (isospectral rigidity / reconstruction). Different axis (L_max-scan vs τ-scan), different
    observable (a₄ magnitude convergence vs multiset identity).
  producing_script: "computations/investigation-5/inv5_w3_1_a4_lmax_convergence.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) — ALL required, ALL non-empty ----

# (1) operator — the mathematical comparison form
operator:
  type: "inequality (monotone-decreasing tail) + ratio (tail-fraction vs residual)"
  form: >
    PASS-truncation iff  [ sign(Δa_4(L)) < 0 for all L ∈ {4,5,(6)} ]  AND
    [ |a_4(L_max) − a_4(3)| / a_4(L_max) ∈ residual-match band around 0.0536 ];
    INFO-physical iff the tail is non-monotone OR converges to a floor whose residual-fraction
    is NOT within the residual-match band (the +5.36% is then NOT an a₄ truncation tail).

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary — exact threshold value + direction
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: >
    two-part: (i) sign(Δa_4(L)) < 0 (strict) for every L-step beyond L=3;
    (ii) tail_fraction = |a_4(L_max) − a_4(3)| / a_4(L_max), PASS-band |tail_fraction − 0.0536| <= 0.0268
    (i.e. tail_fraction ∈ [0.0268, 0.0804] = the +5.36% residual ±50% relative, RATIO tolerance rule);
    INFO-band 0.0804 < |tail_fraction − 0.0536| (or any non-monotone step).
  direction: "< (Δa_4 strictly negative) AND <= (|tail_fraction − 0.0536| within band)"

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically — is the threshold analytically derived?
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: >
    null — the PASS direction (monotone-decreasing extensive tail toward the continuum Gilkey value)
    is the substrate-physics expectation from the R-Protection theorem (a₄ multiset {8,4} vs {6,6} is
    NOT weight-balanced ⇒ a₄ is an unbalanced EXTENSIVE coefficient with an O(L^{d+r+4})-fragile
    truncation tail; spectral-geometer LB1 + C1). The 0.0536 residual-match TARGET is the published
    m_H +5.36% (= (131.8−125.1)/125.1), an EMPIRICAL anchor, not an analytically-derived threshold.
    The direction is a SIGN prediction (substitution chain below); the magnitude band is empirical.

# (4) reachable_rationals — does the admissible region contain a rational mesh?
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: >
    L_max ∈ {3,4,5,(6)} is a 3-to-4-point INTEGER mesh on the truncation axis; a_4(L) is a real-valued
    output per mesh point; the tail-fraction PASS-band [0.0268, 0.0804] is a continuous real interval.

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of producing_script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "4 truncation points (max_pq_sum ∈ {3,4,5,6}; the L_max=6 point is CONDITIONAL on feasibility — see L_max-feasibility pin)"
  L_max: "scan {3,4,5,(6)}; max_pq_sum is the script's truncation parameter (= L_max). L_max_plan = 6; L_max_operational set by the feasibility pre-check below."
  scan_range: "max_pq_sum ∈ [3, 6]; τ FIXED at τ_fold = 0.190 (NOT scanned — this gate scans the L_max axis, not the τ axis)"
  step_size: "ΔL_max = 1 (integer)"
  tolerance: "0.0268 (RATIO half-band on the tail-fraction, = +5.36% residual ±50% relative; heat-kernel fit residual cross-check < 1e-3 on the t⁴·K(t) polynomial fit)"
  scheme: "FW (framework heat-kernel Seeley-DeWitt extraction via spectral_action.extract_seeley_dewitt_robust)"
  convention: "EXTENSIVE-a4-MAGNITUDE (un-protected coefficient; NO a_0/a_2 ratio normalization — the unbalanced extensive magnitude is the object under test, per the Counting axis intensive/extensive discipline of `regulator-pin-discipline.md`)"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (irrep construction + polynomial fit are deterministic)"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 — set os.environ.setdefault('OMP_NUM_THREADS','8') BEFORE import numpy; the per-block irrep matrices at max_pq_sum<=6 are well below the 100×100 GPU-preference threshold (largest single Peter-Weyl block at p+q=6 is small); irrep CONSTRUCTION (recursive Casimir projection), not diagonalization, is the operative cost (`math-scripts.md §\"D_K Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-Projection Feasibility Pre-Check\"`)"
  # CONDITIONAL machinery pins (MANDATORY where they apply):
  regulator_pin: "a_4^{ζ}  — the heat-kernel Seeley-DeWitt extraction is the zeta-regulated coefficient of D_K² at τ_fold (canonical a_4_FW_zeta lineage; `regulator-pin-discipline.md`). Tag the verdict-line convention with the regulator. The extraction is FULL physical (no SCHEMATIC helper consumed — spectral_action.py's extract_seeley_dewitt_robust is the live heat-kernel fit, NOT _spectral_action_regulators.py)."
  CLASS: "FULL  — producing_script consumes spectral_action.py (live heat-kernel extraction) + dirac_spectrum.py (live irrep builder); NEITHER is a SCHEMATIC helper. No `-SCHEMATIC` suffix; no tier_pin row."
  publication_precision: "4 sig figs (a_4 magnitude at each L_max; the tail-fraction reported to 3 sig figs). Downstream consumer = INV5-W3-3 review (reads the verdict/deliverable), so the value is cited downstream — emit full float64 to the .npz, rounded value to the WP."
  # L_max-feasibility pin (MANDATORY at plan-freeze for any gate scanning L_max >= 10 per `math-scripts.md §\"D_K Block-Diagonality\"`; declared here for completeness because the plan asked for it explicitly, and to bound the (6) point):
  L_max_feasibility_argument: >
    The scan tops out at max_pq_sum = 6 (p+q <= 6), FAR below the p+q >= 13 irrep-construction
    infeasibility ceiling (`_s87_w11_irrep13_timing.txt` tracks the p+q=13 timing boundary). Recursive
    Casimir-projection irrep construction at p+q <= 6 completes well within an agent timeslot (empirically
    sub-minute per sector at these ranks). The L_max=6 point is therefore feasibility-CLEAR; it is marked
    CONDITIONAL (the (6) parenthesis) ONLY as a graceful-degradation guard — if the L_max=6 irrep build
    unexpectedly stalls, the gate reports the {3,4,5} slope and tags the verdict honestly (Friedrich-Bär
    structural-saturation cross-check: bound the worst-case NEW sector (p,q) at p+q=6 via
    |λ|_min^(p,q) ≈ √(C_2(p,q)) / r(τ) and confirm its contribution to a_4 is the small tail the slope
    predicts). No sparse-Lanczos / no high-L_max diagonalization is pinned (block-diagonal Peter-Weyl
    storage at these ranks is trivially in-memory). This argument is the `math-scripts.md §\"D_K
    Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-Projection Feasibility Pre-Check\"` Casimir-bound + cache-
    cross-check protocol, scoped to the L_max <= 6 window.

# (6) audit_discriminators — which inputs feed audit_sha256 vs content_sha256
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — mandatory for sign/direction/threshold claims
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "the un-protected a₄ truncation tail DECREASES with L_max toward the continuum (so the m_H
            +5.36% IS a resolvable truncation tail, not a physical floor)."

    Definition 1: a_4(L) := the t² coefficient of the small-t expansion of t⁴·K_L(t), where
                  K_L(t) = Tr_{P^{<=L}} exp(−t D_K²) is the heat trace over the Peter-Weyl truncation
                  at max_pq_sum = L, evaluated at τ_fold = 0.190.  [spectral_action.extract_seeley_dewitt_robust; canonical a_4(fold) = 1350.72 at the working L]
    Definition 2: a_4^{cont} := the continuum Gilkey curvature-polynomial value of the same coefficient
                  (the L → ∞ limit on the underlying homogeneous-space geometry).  [Gilkey heat-kernel]
    Definition 3: tail(L) := a_4(L) − a_4^{cont}  (the truncation residual at truncation L).
    Definition 4: residual_mH := (m_H^FW − m_H^obs)/m_H^obs = (131.8 − 125.1)/125.1 = +0.0536.
                  [canonical m_H_FW_KK_threshold = 131.8; m_H_obs = 125.1]

    Substitute (structural form of the extensive tail, R-Protection theorem):
      a₄ has Peter-Weyl multiset {8,4} which is NOT weight-balanced (≠ {6,6}), so a₄ is an UNBALANCED
      EXTENSIVE coefficient — its truncation tail does NOT cancel (unlike the balanced intensive ratios
      n_s, R_n) and scales as tail(L) ~ C · L^{−p} for some p>0 with C of the sign set by the highest
      retained curvature mode.  [spectral-geometer LB1 + C1; R-Protection theorem S76]

    Simplify:
      Step a:  a_4(L) = a_4^{cont} + tail(L),   tail(L) ~ C · L^{−p}.
      Step b:  Δa_4(L) := a_4(L) − a_4(L−1) = C·(L^{−p} − (L−1)^{−p}).
      Step c:  for p>0 and L>1, L^{−p} < (L−1)^{−p}, so (L^{−p} − (L−1)^{−p}) < 0.
      Step d:  hence sign(Δa_4(L)) = sign(C) · (negative).

    Canonical form:
      sign(Δa_4(L)) < 0  ⇔  C > 0  (the truncation OVER-counts a₄ at finite L and relaxes downward),
      and |tail(3) − tail(L_max)| / a_4(L_max) is the resolvable fraction.

    Direction:
      The SIGN prediction is Δa_4(L) < 0 (monotone-decreasing) IFF C > 0. The compute MEASURES sign(C).
      If the measured tail is monotone-decreasing AND |a_4(L_max) − a_4(3)|/a_4(L_max) ≈ residual_mH,
      the +5.36% is the a₄ extensive truncation tail (RESOLVABLE, L_sat≈6). If the tail is non-monotone
      or floors away from residual_mH, the +5.36% is NOT explained by a₄ truncation (PHYSICAL — routes to
      the W2-3 Pekker-Varma self-energy / the Γ_eff effacement as a derived screening).

    Conclusion:
      The gate is a SIGN-and-MAGNITUDE test of whether the extensive a₄ truncation tail accounts for the
      m_H residual. sign_verdict keys on Δa_4(L) < 0; magnitude_verdict keys on the tail-fraction band;
      the composite collapses per `gate-verdicts.md §"Composite-collapse rule"`.

# (8) input_files — every file the producing_script reads, with SHA pin

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  PASS-truncation: a₄ truncation tail is monotone-decreasing (sign(Δa_4(L)) < 0 for every L-step beyond
  L=3) AND |a_4(L_max) − a_4(3)|/a_4(L_max) ∈ [0.0268, 0.0804] (the +5.36% residual ±50% relative).
  Solution-space reading: the m_H +5.36% / 38.5σ miss IS the un-protected a₄ extensive truncation tail at
  L_sat≈6 — a RESOLVABLE finite-truncation artifact, not new physics. Strengthens the "m_H is the
  a₄-dressed |S|² KK-threshold mode" reading (spectral-geometer C4); de-pressures the Γ_eff=0.99970
  effacement fit; corroborates the INV5-W3-3 review's truncation reading.
FAIL_meaning: >
  FAIL is not a pre-registered token for this gate (the two physical readings are PASS-truncation vs
  INFO-physical; there is no "wrong-answer" outcome — both are informative solution-space positions). A
  FAIL is reserved for the [SIGN] composite-collapse: regime_verdict = BREAKDOWN (the heat-kernel small-t
  fit window leaves its regime of validity, e.g. the t-range is too coarse to resolve the t² coefficient
  at the truncation, so a_4 is not a well-defined read-off) ⇒ composite FAIL. That FAIL means the a₄
  extraction itself is unreliable at that L_max, NOT a physics verdict.
INFO_meaning: >
  INFO-physical: the tail is non-monotone (sign(Δa_4(L)) changes) OR converges to a floor whose
  residual-fraction is OUTSIDE the [0.0268, 0.0804] band. Solution-space reading: the m_H +5.36% is NOT
  the a₄ extensive truncation tail — it is a PHYSICAL residual that must be sourced elsewhere (the W2-3
  Pekker-Varma continuum self-energy as a derived Landau screening, or the Γ_eff effacement). Routes the
  residual to the physical-screening leg of the INV5-W3-3 synthesis. (Per `math-scripts.md §"All Results
  Are Good Results"`, INFO-physical is a structured pre-registered outcome, not an incomplete result.)

# ---- Effort + framing (2 fields) ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/investigation-5/inv5_w3_1_a4_lmax_convergence.py"
    - "computations/investigation-5/inv5_w3_1_a4_lmax_convergence.npz"
    - "computations/investigation-5/inv5_w3_1_a4_lmax_convergence.png"
    - "sessions/investigation/investigation-5/investigation-5-w3-workingpaper.md §W3-1 (section)"
  estimated_time: "~1 wave (the irrep + heat-kernel machinery is on disk; the new work is the L_max scan loop + the slope/tail-fraction read-off + the m_H-residual comparison)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The object under test is a₄ — the fourth Seeley-DeWitt coefficient of the heat trace
  Tr exp(−t D_K²) — which is a spectral moment of D_K, i.e. the fabric's own spectral content at τ_fold,
  not an excitation of it. The arrow runs D_K eigenvalues → the heat-kernel small-t limb → the a₄ moment
  → the emergent Yang-Mills + Higgs-quartic sector (a₄ is the weight-4 moment Phi(a_4) = Σ_3, the
  load-bearing YM+Higgs term per `epistemic-discipline.md §"Layer-Decomposition"` Phi correspondence) →
  the measured m_H. The +5.36% is read substrate-first: the finite Peter-Weyl truncation at L_max=3 is the
  substrate AS-COMPUTED; the question is whether the substrate's OWN a₄ relaxes toward its continuum value
  fast enough that the residual at L_sat≈6 IS the +5.36% (the substrate IS the truncation tail), with no
  container-side "correction" invoked. The un-protected EXTENSIVE character (multiset {8,4} ≠ {6,6}, not
  weight-balanced) is why a₄ — unlike the intensive R-protected ratios — carries a non-cancelling tail at
  all: the substrate's geometry, not an external regulator, sets the convergence.
```

## §W3-2. INV5-W3-2

```yaml
# ---- Identity (7 fields) ----

  effective action / free energy — same functional as the order-parameter free energy in different
```

## Wave 3 → inv-5 Close Decision Point

This is the terminal wave of investigation-5; W3 feeds the inv-5 close (and `/rclab-investigate --investigation 5`), not a downstream wave. Branching by outcome:

- **INV5-W3-1 → PASS-truncation** (a₄ tail monotone-decreasing, tail-fraction ∈ [0.0268, 0.0804]): the m_H +5.36% is the resolvable a₄ extensive truncation tail at L_sat≈6. Feeds the INV5-W3-3 review's TRUNCATION leg as a PASS; corroborates spectral-geometer C4/R4. Carry-forward candidate (session-track, NOT an investigation edit): a higher-L_max convergence confirmation if L_max=6 was the operational ceiling.
- **INV5-W3-1 → INFO-physical** (non-monotone or floor outside the band): the +5.36% is NOT the a₄ truncation tail; routes to the W2-3 Pekker-Varma self-energy / Γ_eff effacement as the physical-screening explanation. Feeds the INV5-W3-3 review's PHYSICAL leg.
- **INV5-W3-1 → FAIL** (regime BREAKDOWN — a₄ read-off unreliable at the truncation): the heat-kernel small-t fit window is too coarse to resolve the t² coefficient at L_max; the truncation reading is UNDECIDED, and the review reports the a₄-tail leg as inconclusive. Carry-forward (session-track): refine the t-range / n_points of the heat-kernel fit.
- **INV5-W3-2 → LANDED with STRUCTURAL VERDICT** (Reading-1 same-functional OR Reading-2 categorically-distinct): the two-effective-actions tension is pinned; the named decisive forward compute of sub-question (c) is a carry-forward candidate for a future session-track gate (and for `/rclab-investigate`). If the verdict is Reading-2 (categorically-distinct), it sharpens the atlas-04 S3 status (SA-is-the-effective-action ASSUMED → scoped to the geometry/gauge sector, NOT the order-parameter / CC sector) — a capstone-hygiene Q3 candidate routed to the session track (NOT an investigation edit).
- **INV5-W3-2 → LANDED CONVERGENCE-DEFERRED** (no single Reading in 2 rounds): both readings + both decisive gates are pinned and carried to the inv-5 close.
- **INV5-W3-3 → LANDED** (full three-way OR PARTIAL-PENDING): the Higgs-residual joint picture is the inv-5 close's headline synthesis for convergence #1. If PARTIAL-PENDING, the missing-leg full comparison is a carry-forward to a session-track re-synthesis once the missing compute lands.

All W3 outputs are exploratory-track deliverables; any permanent landing (canonical_constants pin, falsifier-master-inventory row, registry §VII entry, capstone status edit, the HY1 A_s canonical-constants pin) is a SESSION-TRACK promotion (`/rclab-investigate` lifts them into the housekeeping ledger at close; mack is the sole writer of the falsifier surface) — NOT an investigation edit (`gate-verdicts.md §"Track-local boundary"`).

## Wave 3 Machinery-Enumeration Pin

Only the COMPUTE gate (INV5-W3-1) contributes a producing-script machinery pin; the workshop (INV5-W3-2) and review (INV5-W3-3) contribute nothing here (no producing script — they close by artifact-existence). This is the subset `_yaml_gate_validator.py` reads for the compute gate.

**INV5-W3-1** (`computations/investigation-5/inv5_w3_1_a4_lmax_convergence.py`):
- `N_eval` = 4 truncation points (max_pq_sum ∈ {3,4,5,6}; the 6-point CONDITIONAL on the L_max-feasibility pre-check)
- `L_max` = scan {3,4,5,(6)}; L_max_plan = 6; L_max_operational set by the Casimir-bound + Friedrich-Bär feasibility pre-check (the scan tops out far below the p+q≥13 infeasibility ceiling)
- `scan_range` = max_pq_sum ∈ [3, 6]; τ FIXED at τ_fold = 0.190 (L_max axis, NOT τ axis — the structural distinction from inv-3 INV3-W2-2)
- `step_size` = ΔL_max = 1 (integer)
- `tolerance` = 0.0268 (RATIO half-band on the tail-fraction = +5.36% ±50% relative); heat-kernel polynomial-fit residual < 1e-3
- `scheme` = FW (heat-kernel Seeley-DeWitt extraction)
- `convention` = EXTENSIVE-a4-MAGNITUDE (un-protected; no a_0/a_2 ratio normalization)
- `random_seed` = N/A — deterministic
- `GPU_path` = cpu-cap-OMP8 (irrep CONSTRUCTION, not diagonalization, is the cost; blocks at p+q≤6 are sub-100×100)
- `regulator_pin` = a_4^{ζ} (zeta-regulated fourth Seeley-DeWitt coefficient; verdict-line convention carries the regulator tag)
- `CLASS` = FULL (spectral_action.py + dirac_spectrum.py are live, NOT SCHEMATIC; no `-SCHEMATIC` suffix, no tier_pin row)
- `publication_precision` = 4 sig figs (a₄ magnitude); 3 sig figs (tail-fraction); full float64 to .npz, rounded to WP (downstream consumer = INV5-W3-3)
- `L_max_feasibility_argument` = Casimir-bound + Friedrich-Bär saturation per `math-scripts.md §"D_K Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-Projection Feasibility Pre-Check"`, scoped to L_max ≤ 6 (feasibility-CLEAR; the (6) point is a graceful-degradation guard, not a high-L_max risk)
